html:
Local Estate Jewelry Buyers

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers from people looking to sell estate jewelry or get an appraisal. The first 3 leads are free, then you pay $40 for each lead you accept.

How It Works

  1. Receive leads – Leads come from people looking to sell estate jewelry, get an appraisal, or buy a ring.
  2. Accept a lead – Pay $40 for each accepted lead, after the first 3 free.
  3. Optional Pro website widget – $12/month.

CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to other metros.

FAQ

What happens after I accept a lead? Once you accept a lead, you can contact the person and proceed with the sale or appraisal directly.

Is there a minimum number of leads? No. You pay only for the leads you choose to accept.

Next Step
